info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Document Update API
info.description: The Document Update API enables users to modify existing banking documents efficiently. This endpoint is designed for updating specific document attributes or metadata, ensuring that the information remains accurate and up-to-date. Typical consumers of this API include banking institutions and service providers that require agile management of documentation workflows. With this API, organizations can ensure compliance and improve operational efficiency by seamlessly refining document details as needed.

patch.description: This operation allows you to update the details of a specific document service identified by its resource identifier. Ensure that you provide the necessary attributes in the request body to modify the document service accordingly.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to partially update the document identified by RES-100045. It should contain the fields that need to be modified along with their new values.

changes.description: Contains the changes that need to be made to the document.

changeReason.description: The reason for the changes being requested.

effectiveAt.description: The date and time when the changes should take effect.

requestedBy.description: The identifier of the user or system requesting the changes.
